clusters.label: The feed is on trial
clusters.why: A regulatory inquiry landed the same week two viral threads accused platforms of throttling reach, so the two stories merged.

clusters.label: Nobody / me at 3am
clusters.why: A caption template that resurfaces every few months; this week's wave started from a single post that hit the front page.

six-seven.name: Six-seven
six-seven.what: A number chant lifted from a rap lyric that spread through short-form video, where creators shout it over unrelated footage. It became a generational in-joke, then a parody of adults trying to explain it.

nobody-me-at.name: "Nobody: / Me:"
nobody-me-at.what: A caption format where an imagined silence is followed by the poster doing something unprompted. It has been recycled since roughly 2019 and is now used semi-ironically.

italian-brainrot.name: Italian brainrot
italian-brainrot.what: AI-narrated absurd creatures with pseudo-Italian names, born from jokes about text-to-speech accents. It grew into a shared universe with fan-made lore and merchandise.
